@doctorsaluja @mrmickme2 hMPV turning into severe illnesses raises the question of an underlying immunocompromising illness. 
Besides multiple SC2 infections, I would still check TBC and HIV.

@doctorsaluja @mrmickme2 Totally agree. And China has the added problem of the after-effects of the full-virus Covid vaccine (ADE).
